prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: I was reminiscing about that Xi'an trip last year—funny how I ended up browsing a bunch of local attractions and even random online courses around the same time.
Oh, and I still remember my package drama back then—tracking number SF1234567890. It eventually showed up, but I was refreshing updates like a maniac.
We did the Terracotta Warriors on 2025-03-27, and my cousin Zhang Wei handled the tickets—he picked an afternoon slot and got 5 of them for the group.

Same week, my friend joked that I’d finally stop procrastinating if I enrolled—turns out it was literally called "Python Programming Basics" and it was under Liu Yang’s name. Also, Zhang Wei was the one listed on those Terracotta Warriors tickets, not me.
